title: Late compensation and joint frame refinement: conditional κ = 4.24830828577e-4
body:
**κ ≈ 4.24830828577 × 10⁻⁴.**

Delay old-value compensation reads until their actual dependencies require them, reuse the newly available scratch banks, and jointly optimize the physical operation frames. This improves the retained h22 sequential-cover construction in #142 by about **1.11%**, with the same inherited multiplication interfaces.

The literal scalar DAG stays fixed. A read deadline precedes both the recipient's first workspace gate and every strictly larger gauge read on its reached targets. A donor may be reused only after its last actual workspace use and before that correction. This adds **780** disjoint handoffs to the existing **1,703**, reducing persistent local scratch from **21,274 to 20,494** slots. Omitted and prematurely executed corrections are rejected by numerical controls and exact chronology checks.

The additional frame search moves connected groups of equal operation frames, prioritizes compatible donor dimensions, adjusts source gauges while respecting the exact read deadlines, and allows handoff frames to change inside their verified containment bounds. Those deterministic searches select the word; the independent literal audit and exact moments validate it. Scalar coefficients, root interfaces and actual inverse chronology remain fully checked.

|---|---:|
| Local / ambient dimension | 22 / 66 |

| Deficit | 5,082 |

The exact complex-side saving is **4.25192098 × 10⁻⁴**. The retained weighted bit supplier supports **4.5060418316 × 10⁻⁴**, including its full fallback and atom conversion. The complete finite group stock, virtual-role scalar reserve, routers, auxiliary adapters, data finishes and row budget are paid. The independent audit counts all **7,075,117** scalar operations per stage. Final assembly uses positive rational slack and checks all 47 strict constraints, seven margins and rejection of the next grid point.

**Validation:** a fresh deterministic reconstruction from the original pinned PR117 witness reproduces the restricted DAG, operation frames, gauges, pairs and read deadlines. Its full literal forward/reflected audit passes, including arbitrary dirty scratch restoration. Geometry checks all 1,540 ports and 246 physical source-frame types. All **46 corruption controls pass**. The repaired full frozen aggregate passes, including byte-identical regenerated receipts and the unchanged-source check. All 45 CI checks pass on repaired head `803b28a5e373442974385396e9d4d3f6e75fd5e7`.

**Receipt repair:** the first frozen receipt included an authoring-only `reproduction` field that the audit CLI never emits. The CLI receipt has replaced it, its dependent geometry/certificate hashes and source manifest were regenerated, and the existing canonical-receipt control now rejects that field. The compiler output, mathematical checks and claimed saving are unchanged. All 46 publication controls and the complete aggregate pass on the repaired head.

```sh
python3 research/cover-local-reuse/verify.py
```

The verifier rebuilds the source closure in a temporary copy, requires byte-identical generated profiles and receipts, and requires the frozen package to remain unchanged. The focused CI matrix uses Python 3.11, 3.13 and 3.14. `LATE-REUSE.md`, `REFINEMENT.md`, `PADDED-GEOMETRY.md` and `BIT-PADDED.md` describe the finite construction beside its code.

This remains a conditional finite witness for `T(n) = O(n(log n)^(1−κ))`. General Clifford normal forms, common generic bases, uniform weighted local-ring compilation, restored row borrowing, analytic recovery and fixed-tape transfer remain explicit inherited contracts.
